title: 各门店按月汇总
description: 每家门店每月的订单数、营业额和客单价（元）。读 data/cafe.db 的 daily_sales 和 stores。

args.sql:
SELECT s.store, s.district, substr(d.day, 1, 7) AS month,
  SUM(d.orders) AS orders,
  ROUND(SUM(d.revenue), 2) AS revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(d.revenue) / SUM(d.orders), 2) AS ticket
FROM daily_sales d JOIN stores s ON s.store = d.store
GROUP BY s.store, s.district, month
ORDER BY month, revenue DESC
